project1.label: Kitchen
project1.title: Japandi-style kitchen
project1.description:
A kitchen designed for every centimetre.

In this apartment we created a fully bespoke kitchen: oak veneer and solid oak, finished with Rubio Monocoat 2C oil. Countertop and wall cladding in Travertino marble. Integrated LED lighting running the full length. Oak parquet flooring matched to the cabinetry. Every element designed and crafted to fit the existing space.

project2.label:
Wine rack
cabinet
project2.title: Wine rack + TV unit
project2.description:
From drawing to finished product — all made by us.

This wine cabinet was born from scratch: the client had a complex space to make the most of — a wall, an air-conditioning unit already installed, and the need to combine a wine rack and a TV unit into a single bespoke piece. We designed it with concealed power sockets and an integrated LED lighting system, for an elegant, perfectly functional result that adapts to the existing spaces and installations.

project3.label:
Dovetail
joinery
project3.title: Dovetail joinery
project3.description:
The dovetail joint never goes out of style.

An interlock that holds itself together — no screws, no visible glue, just wood holding wood. Sturdy, honest, built to last.

Pictured here is a cutlery drawer for a custom kitchen. But we can craft any furniture interior with this technique: drawers, dividers, cutlery trays. Done well, it has few rivals — you can see and feel that it's real woodworking.

As always, we recommend finishing solid wood with oil: it keeps the wood natural to the touch, and today's oils like Rubio Monocoat hold their own against traditional finishes when it comes to durability.

project4.label:
Raffia
boiserie
project4.title: Raffia boiserie
project4.description:
Raffia boiserie for a built-in wardrobe.

In this project we lined the interior of a built-in wardrobe with raffia panels, separated by solid oak strips. All made to measure.

There was a niche in the wall — we closed it with concealed doors, integrated into the panelling: invisible at first glance, practical when needed.

Raffia, with its wide natural weave, gives a neat and elegant look without overwhelming the space. And it's not just about aesthetics: raffia panels provide excellent sound and thermal insulation — one of the main requirements of this project.

We create any custom project, from design to assembly.

slide2.label: Parquet
slide2.title:
Parquet
laying
slide2.body:
We lay parquet of any complexity and geometry.

We work with Italy’s leading producers and with local makers we know personally — for honest quality and the living character of the wood.

slide3.label: Restoration
slide3.title:
Furniture
restoration
slide3.body:
We restore furniture — bringing pieces back to life while preserving their story.

We are at home with delicate materials such as teak and rare exotic woods, choosing the right method and finish for every surface with care.

slide4.label: Boiserie
slide4.title:
Boiserie
and panelling
slide4.body:
We craft boiserie — wall panelling that gives character to an entire interior.

We work with fabric and wood, finish with oil, and master rich, expressive staining that brings out the texture and depth of the material.
